CFML Language Reference: Functions

Duplicate

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Makes a deep copy of a variable. Structures, arrays and queries nested at any depth are copied too, so nothing is shared between the original and the copy.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

Duplicate(variable)

Parameters

variable
Any variable: a simple value, array, structure or query.

Returns

A copy of the value.

Usage

Use Duplicate whenever you need a private copy of a structure or query, for example to copy a structure out of the Session or Application scope so that you only need a CFLOCK for the copy itself, not for every later read.

Assignment copies arrays but not structures or queries; StructCopy copies only the top level of a structure. See StructCopy for a comparison table.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET App = StructNew()>
<CFSET App.Settings = StructNew()>
<CFSET App.Settings.Theme = "Classic">
<CFSET App.Users = QueryNew("Name")>
<CFSET Temp = QueryAddRow(App.Users)>
<CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(App.Users, "Name", "Ann")>

<CFSET Mine = Duplicate(App)>
<CFSET Mine.Settings.Theme = "Hot Dog Stand">
<CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(Mine.Users, "Name", "Bob", 1)>

<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>&nbsp;</TH><TH>Settings.Theme</TH><TH>Users.Name</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>App (original)</TD><TD>#App.Settings.Theme#</TD><TD>#App.Users.Name#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Mine (Duplicate)</TD><TD>#Mine.Settings.Theme#</TD><TD>#Mine.Users.Name#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
